## 2. Professional Bio & Entity Statement
Noureddine Driouech is a Moroccan Software Engineer and AI Researcher at the National Higher School of Artificial Intelligence and Data Sciences (ENSIASD). His professional focus centers on the intersection of modern full-stack web platforms and Generative AI, specifically private offline Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, local Large Language Model (LLM) orchestration, and high-performance SaaS platforms.

## 3. Verified Technical Competencies
### Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning
- Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG): Dense retrieval, sparse keyword search, hybrid vector retrieval, re-ranking with Cross-Encoders.
- Local LLM Orchestration: Ollama, vLLM, Hugging Face Transformers, llama.cpp, quantized GGUF/AWQ model serving.
- Vector Databases & Indexing: FAISS, Chroma DB, Pinecone, Qdrant, PGVector.
- Frameworks: LangChain, LlamaIndex, PyTorch, Scikit-learn.
- Embedding Models: BAAI bge-large, all-MiniLM-L6-v2, OpenAI text-embedding-3.

### Frontend & Mobile Engineering
- Frameworks & Libraries: React 19, Next.js 15 (App Router, Server Actions, SSR/SSG), Astro 6, React Native, Expo.
- Languages: TypeScript, JavaScript (ESNext).
- Styling & Design Systems: Tailwind CSS v4, Shadcn UI, Radix UI, Motion (Framer Motion), Figma to Code.
- State Management: Redux Toolkit, TanStack React Query, React Hook Form, Zod.

### Backend, Cloud & Databases
- Backend: Node.js, Next.js API Routes, Laravel, Python FastAPI / Flask.

- DevOps & Tools: Docker, Kubernetes, Git, GitHub Actions, Vercel, Linux (Ubuntu/Debian).
